name: Supplies to Private Thorsen
label: Quest
description: Krazek in Booty Bay hires a courier to haul miscellaneous goblin supplies north to Lieutenant Doren's camp. Local troll aggression has halted routine…
intro: Krazek in Booty Bay hires a courier to haul miscellaneous goblin supplies north to Lieutenant Doren's camp. Local troll aggression has halted routine shipments, requiring an outside hand to ensure the goods reach Private Thorsen near the northern border.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hmm. Yes, I do have something you could do, actually. Lieutenant Doren and his followers up in the north need their regular supplies from us.

They haven't been delivered, and with the trolls attacking, I'll need someone to do it. Doren's camp lies northwest of the road at the entrance to Stranglethorn from Duskwood. Give the supplies to Private Thorsen, if he's not in the camp, then he'll be patrolling south of it. He'll take care of them.
Mind you, if you fail, you'll owe me restitution.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes? What do you want? Oh, supplies from the goblins. Strange seeing a traveler delivering them, usually they send their own. No matter... You didn't touch them did you? Good good... We wouldn't want anything to happen to our mines, oh no.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These land mines will help us defend ourselves from that animal Kurzen and his men. Thank you for bringing them. If you need further work, I can probably find something for you to do. And you won't have to deal with those goblins, hm?
